title: SSL & HTTPS Setup
description: Move a WordPress site to HTTPS — certificate, URL updates, mixed content, and redirect rules.

steps.title: Install SSL Certificate
steps.instructions: Enable SSL via your host panel (Let's Encrypt or commercial cert). Confirm https:// loads without browser warnings.

steps.title: Update WordPress & Site URLs
steps.instructions: Set WordPress Address and Site Address to https:// under Settings → General. Fix any hardcoded http:// in options if needed.

steps.title: Force HTTP → HTTPS Redirect
steps.instructions: Add a server-level 301 redirect from HTTP to HTTPS. Avoid redirect loops with CDN or reverse-proxy configs.

steps.title: Fix Mixed Content Warnings
steps.instructions: Scan key pages for insecure images, scripts, or embeds still loading over HTTP. Update media URLs and embed codes.

steps.title: Force SSL for wp-admin
steps.instructions: Add define('FORCE_SSL_ADMIN', true); to wp-config.php if admin is not already HTTPS-only.

steps.title: Enable HSTS (Optional)
steps.instructions: Add Strict-Transport-Security header only after HTTPS is stable site-wide. Start with a short max-age during testing.

steps.title: Update Search Console Property
steps.instructions: Add the HTTPS property in Google Search Console. Submit the sitemap and set preferred domain if applicable.
